notes:
EVERLIGHT GARDEN: Ethereum chain 1; deploy only src/WishGarden.sol:WishGarden(address owner_). $owner resolves to 0x48E4E74fE1d0c14404cEB57B9fec5b21329C6ec9, never the factory. Nonpayable constructor, no external calls; starts activated=false, purchasesPaused=true. WishGardenTreasury and EverlightBridgeQueue are abstract inherited components. No launch initialization or ETH funding. Ethereum ABI: docs/abi/WishGarden.json.

1 IMD (18 decimals) buys a permanent nontransferable candle; batches of 1-50 have sequential IDs, immutable purchaser=beneficiary, timestamps, seven styles and optional individual wishes. Wishes are public forever in Ethereum storage/events, immutable, strict UTF-8, <=280 codepoints and <=1120 bytes. No global cap or expiry. Split: 30% restricted burn queue, 30% earlier paid candles, 30% ecosystem, 5% operations, 5% founder. First-candle rewards go to ecosystem. Allocation precedes each new weight, including within batches. Claims pay only the beneficiary, remain open during purchase pauses and are backed by held IMD. Earned/claimed/claimable are separate; division dust stays restricted, never rewarding later entrants. Only the three fee buckets are owner-withdrawable to explicit destinations with amount/destination events.

Rewards come ONLY from later candle purchases, not external business yield; no later purchases means no new rewards and no guaranteed return. Same-wallet purchases can return a partial self-share, not profit. Ecosystem investments grant no financial rights. No lottery, NFT rights, free claims, new token, pool, website, legacy sweep or retrospective rewards. Both legacy contracts stay separate and untouched.

Base EverlightBurnReceiver is EXCLUDED; source/ABI and unsigned owner deployment package: src/base/ and docs/base/. Activation blockers: confirmed Ethereum address; owner-signed Base deployment/source/runtime verification; current official peers, endpoint libraries/DVNs/executor/security, token restrictions and adapter collateral; both-direction fee/gas simulations; actual receiver and shared reviewed evidence hash; Base activation and authenticated readiness before Ethereum activation. See docs/deployment.md and docs/verification.md. Owner evidence must reconcile the supplied Base token's observed Fren Pet branding. Rates are constants; application bridge configuration freezes on activation. The fixed OFT route uses zero allowance (approvalRequired()==false). Gas is funded separately. Failed source sends retain reservations for same-job retry; in-transit sends cannot be resent. Only authenticated confirmation of the receiver's exact balance/totalSupply-reducing burn increments confirmedBurn. Pending amounts are not confirmed burns. External bridge/token administrators remain a liveness/security dependency.

Imported audit rechecked against accepted source; defects no longer reproduce: 91c591583507 (30/30/30/5/5, prior-candle ledger and protected liabilities); ac84f5a07750 (NFT/free paths removed); 79e7a9386e40 (sink replaced by queue and Base burner); 9696c3b9f897 (wish arrays/storage/events/strict UTF-8); 4d0f04b90423 (no bindGarden/recordPayment/collection confirmation; later bridge activation is explicitly required by the brief); eeffc9bf8bbe (all buckets follow current owner); 0a554dce471b (stale manifest was absent; this names only accepted WishGarden); ce33b1e7f971 (docs disclose public wishes and later-purchase-only rewards). fc5fdc2cdcba is a coverage statement, not a defect.

Local forge build --offline and forge test --offline passed: 80 tests with the supplied fuzz seed. Model/mock and captured-bytecode evidence is not fork/live bridge certification or final independent approval. Owners.protected.t.sol imports absent floor/OwnerChecks.sol; that harness was not run. No publication, deployment, live burn or real-fund purchase is claimed. Publication, addresses and independent review remain network steps.
